description: Item 11: does raising the loop caps to accommodate window lengths w in {20,30,50} -- approaching or exceeding the default 30-nt cap, and the paper's own motivating applications (siRNA/ASO ~15-25nt, RBP footprints ~50nt) -- restore accuracy on its own, or does beam width also need to increase? Fresh Raccess Exact reference computed for this access_len set (the Table 1/S3 exact reference only has w in {1,3,7,10}); LinearRaccess run at beam=100 and beam=200, both with c_multi=c_hairpin=60 (>= the largest tested w); Raccess Window (W=100) run for comparison. Supports Discussion and Supplementary S4.
all_runs_status: 1770/1770 SUCCESS for every method (exact, linear beam=100/200, window)
